body.en: In $a \le px + q < b$, do the same operation to all three parts. Subtract $q$ throughout, then divide by $p$; if $p < 0$, reverse both signs. Exam layer: $|x - a| < r$ means $a - r < x < a + r$, and $|x - a| > r$ means $x < a - r$ or $x > a + r$.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಅಸಮತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಮೂರೂ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ. |x − a| < r ಎಂದರೆ a − r < x < a + r.

narration.en: For a double inequality, apply each step to all three parts at once. An absolute value inequality, x minus a less than r, means x is within r of a.

caption.en: |x − a| < r: all points within distance r of a. The ends are a − r and a + r.

tryThis.en: a = 1, r = 3: the solution is −2 < x < 4.
